study_identification_part.si3_author_journal_year: Fraza et al., Nature Mental Health, 2024
study_identification_part.si4_title: Unraveling the link between CNVs, cognition and individual neuroimaging deviation scores from a population-based reference cohort

study_characteristics_part.sc1_study_objective: Construct large-scale normative models across neuroimaging modalities (IDPs and voxel-wise Jacobians) and apply them to UK Biobank carriers of pathogenic CNVs to quantify individual deviation profiles and relate deviations to cognition.

rci1_dataset_name.answer: Cam-CAN; HCP; OASIS; PNC; UK Biobank
rci1_dataset_name.reason: The voxel-wise normative model pooled Jacobian data from five public repositories; IDP analysis used UK Biobank. The Methods explicitly list Cam-CAN, HCP, OASIS, PNC, and UK Biobank.
rci1_dataset_name.supporting_text: "we pooled a large dataset from five publicly available repositories: Cam-CAN, HCP, Oasis, PNC and UK Biobank"; "IDPs from the UK Biobank"
rci1_dataset_name.location: Fraza2023.pdf.md: Methods / Participant demographics and data sources, L337-L339; Methods / Study workflow and data summary, L327

rci2_hc_n.reason: The paper reports two separate analyses. For the Jacobian normative model (whole-brain voxel-wise analysis), 19,620 participants passed visual quality control and were used. For the IDP analysis, 43,893 participants from UK Biobank were used. These numbers are clearly stated in Table 1, Table 2, and the flowchart (Fig. 2).
rci2_hc_n.supporting_text: In total, we used visually quality-controlled T1 Jacobian data from 19,620 participants from seven sites... For this study, we used 43,893 participants, and for the Jacobian-voxel-based study, we used 19,620 visually quality-controlled participants.
rci2_hc_n.location: Fraza2023.pdf.md: Methods / Participant demographics and data sources, L337; Fig. 1 caption, L83

rci3_hc_age.reason:
ヤコビアン分析のノルマティブ・モデリングに使用された**合計19,620人**の参加者データセット（Cam-CAN、HCP、OASIS、PNC、UK Biobankの5つのリポジトリから集約）について、ソースには全体としての平均年齢と標準偏差は**明示的に記載されていません**。

しかし、ソースに記載されている各データセットの年齢データ を用いて、参加者数を重みとして計算すると、以下の結果が得られます。

（以下の値は、出典に示されたN数、平均年齢、標準偏差を用いて算出したものです。これらの計算結果そのものは、出典に直接記述されているものではありません。）

| 統計量 | 値 |
| :--- | :--- |
| **全体としての平均年齢 (Weighted Mean Age)** | **約 58.05 歳** |
| **全体としての標準偏差 (Pooled Standard Deviation)** | **約 16.45** |

このデータセットは、PNCの**8歳**からOASISの**97歳**まで、広範な年齢層（ヤコビアンノルマティブ・モデルの目的である全年齢層をカバーするため）を包含しています。

| :--- | :--- | :--- | :--- |

| PNC | 1,296 | 14.37 (3.45) | 8–21 |

総参加者数は、視覚的な品質管理を通過したT1ヤコビアンデータを持つ**19,620人**です。

caa2_diseases_studied.answer: Pathogenic copy number variant (CNV) carrier status (e.g., 1q21.1 deletion; 1q21.1 duplication; Others)
caa2_diseases_studied.reason: The study investigates brain deviation profiles in carriers of pathogenic CNVs rather than specific clinical diagnoses.

clinical_application_and_analysis_part.caa8_key_findings_brief: Pathogenic CNV carriers exhibit heterogeneous, individualized neuroanatomical deviation profiles; specific regions show pronounced deviations in highlighted CNVs (e.g., cerebellum/brainstem/pallidum in some 1q21.1dup; caudate/accumbens in some 1q21.1del); greater negative deviations associate with lower general cognitive ability.
